summary: Game crashes when dispensing a shulker box from a dispenser - "java.lang.NullPointerException: Exception while ticking"
description: (1.16 Pre-Release 3) [^crash-2020-06-10_18.21.22-server.txt] Description: Exception while ticking java.lang.NullPointerException: Exception while ticking at bil.a(SourceFile:88) at gy.a(SourceFile:23) at gu.dispense(SourceFile:15) at bxc.a(SourceFile:89) at bxc.a(SourceFile:112) at cfi$a.a(SourceFile:865) at zd.b(SourceFile:596) at zd$$Lambda$3895/290764432.accept(Unknown Source) at bqn.b(SourceFile:84) at zd.a(SourceFile:351) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:873) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:813) at eox.a(SourceFile:93) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.v(SourceFile:672) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:256) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer$$Lambda$3883/2115162896.run(Unknown Source) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition 1.16 Pre-Release 3.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Place a dispenser in the world.
4. Fill the dispenser with a shulker box.
5. Activate the dispenser to dispense the shulker box.
6. Observe that the game crashes immediately with a "java.lang.NullPointerException: Exception while ticking" error.
Observed Behavior: The game crashes when attempting to dispense a shulker box from a dispenser, resulting in a java.lang.NullPointerException with the message "Exception while ticking." This issue was encountered in version 1.16 Pre-Release 3. The crash occurs specifically during the ticking process, as indicated by the stack trace that reveals the error originates from various source files related to block and item handling within the game. The crash happens immediately upon dispensing the shulker box, regardless of the surrounding conditions. Players have reported that after logging back into the world, the dispenser remains powered, yet the shulker box item is still inside the dispenser. Some players also noted instances of shulker box duplication occurring after the crash. The underlying cause appears to be related to the dispenser's attempt to call a method intended for player interactions, which leads to a null player reference being passed, triggering the NullPointerException. This issue has been confirmed by multiple users and suggests a need for a code adjustment to prevent the dispenser from generating a null player reference during the dispensing process.
Expected Behavior: When dispensing a shulker box from a dispenser, the game should successfully place the shulker box in the world without crashing. The dispenser should function as intended, placing the shulker box at the designated location, and the player should be able to interact with the shulker box afterward. This behavior should be consistent and stable in Java Edition 1.16 Pre-Release 3, ensuring no exceptions are thrown during the process.
